status: proposed with contract 0.7.0; wording owned by Person Two

limits.sms_charset: GSM-7 basic set only (no emoji, curly quotes, dashes or extension characters)

business.rule: business_name, cut at a word and never more than 30

service.rule: the request's service_name, cut at a word

window.rule: from needed_by in the supplier's time zone, or 'as soon as possible'

time.rule: h:mmam/pm; prefixed with a 3-letter day when not today

optin_confirm.when: after the web form or a staff entry; the only text before consent
optin_confirm.body: PLUG: {business} asked to get nearby customer requests by text. Reply START to agree. Msg frequency varies. Msg&data rates may apply. HELP for help, STOP to opt out. Terms: {terms_url}

optin_confirmed.when: START, from pending_confirmation, paused or revoked
optin_confirmed.body: PLUG: You're in. We'll text you when a nearby customer needs you. Reply PAUSE for a 24h break, STOP to opt out, HELP for help.

outreach.when: the supplier is matched; opens an outreach context
outreach.body: PLUG: New request {distance} away. {service}, {window}, {budget}. Reply YES <price> <time> (like YES 30 2:15pm) or NO within {minutes} min. STOP to opt out.

offer_received.body: PLUG: Offer sent: {price} at {time}. We'll text you if the customer picks it.

offer_incomplete.body: PLUG: Add your price and time, like YES 30 2:15pm. Or reply NO.

offer_over_budget.body: PLUG: The customer's budget is {budget_amount}. Reply YES <price> <time> at or under it, or NO.

offer_outside_window.body: PLUG: The customer needs it {window}. Reply YES <price> <time> in that window, or NO.

unparseable.when: result unparseable inside a context, once per context
unparseable.body: PLUG: Sorry, we didn't understand that. Reply YES <price> <time>, NO, or HELP.

request_closed.when: result no_open_context within 24h of a context closing, once
request_closed.body: PLUG: That request has closed, so nothing was sent. We'll text you about the next one.

reservation_request.when: the asker selected this supplier's offer; opens a reservation context
reservation_request.body: PLUG: The customer picked your offer: {price} at {time}. Reply CONFIRM {ref} to book, or RELEASE {ref} if you can't, within {minutes} min.

booked.body: PLUG: Booked, ref {ref}: {service} at {time} for {price}. The customer will show you this ref. HELP for support.

released.body: PLUG: Released ref {ref}. The customer has been told.

reservation_timed_out.body: PLUG: Ref {ref} wasn't confirmed in time, so the customer was shown other options.

reservation_canceled.when: the asker canceled after selecting or after confirmation
reservation_canceled.body: PLUG: The customer cancelled ref {ref}. You don't need to do anything.

help.when: result help; also Twilio's HELP reply
help.body: PLUG sends you nearby customer requests. Reply YES <price> <time> to offer, NO to skip, PAUSE for a 24h break, STOP to opt out. Help: {support}

stop_confirm.when: result stop; also Twilio's STOP reply
stop_confirm.body: PLUG: You're opted out and won't get more texts. Reply START to opt back in.

pause_confirm.body: PLUG: Paused until {until}. Reply START to resume sooner, or STOP to opt out.

provider_match.when: an in-app provider is matched, inside the hourly cap
provider_match.title: New request nearby
provider_match.body: {service}, {distance} away, {window}. Tap to offer or decline.
